senses.gloss: (b. h.) to stand, be erect.—Denom. יְצִיבָה.—V. נָצַב.
to place one’s self; to be firm.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 22:29">Prov. XXII, 29</cite>) <he>מִתְיַצְּבִים בתורה</he> they are firm in the Law.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 6:1">Pesik. R. s. 6</cite> (ref. to Prov. l. c.) <he>בל יִתְיַיצָּב לפני פרעה וכ׳</he> he will not place himself (praying) before Pharaoh, the benighted (v. <cite ref="H01820"><he>חָשׁוּךְ</he></cite>); Cant. R. l. c. <he>לפני מלכי תורה יתיצב</he> he will be placed before (ranked as the foremost of) the kings of the Law; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:1:1">Koh. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>לפני מלאכים יתי׳</he> he will be ranked before angels; a. e.
